title: From noisy to polished, how to clean up AI pixel art assets
author: Rsloth
selftext:
More quick tips for going from dirty AI outputs to clean assets for your games:

* AI does not generate transparent backgrounds. Ask for a solid color.
* Consistency is key for good looking games
* Reduce complexity (and file size) by reducing colors
* Power of 2 sized assets are ideal (64, 128, 256, 512, etc.)

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: You can use any AI image gen to generate pixel art > drag and drop it into [MagicPixel](https://magicpixel.art) and then normalize it from there. Or you can generate assets natively within the app.
